formattedAddress: No. 97號, Yanshou St, Xindong Village, Songshan District, Taipei City, Taiwan 105

text.text:
Traditional chinese restaurant with authentic dishes. The food is tasty. The service is efficient and quick.
The staff are nice and the owner is very active and warm welcoming.
The crispy chicken is a must order, and the cabbage & tofu salad is good.
The beef rolls are delicious.
The menu is in Chinese. Therefore, it is better to come with a local friend or point de food on other tables or show them my below pictures
Highly recommend.
